persona: C++ developer who moved a security product's agent to Rust
resumeText:
Ishaan Mehta | Hyderabad | ishaan.mehta@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Designed a sharded storage service for audit events with the team architect.
- Expose agent configuration through REST APIs built with Axum.
- Write unit and integration tests with cargo test for every crate.
- Deploy services on Linux servers with systemd and Docker.

C++ Developer, Banjara Software, Hyderabad (2018 - 2020)
- Maintained a multithreaded C++ packet parser using the STL.

SKILLS
Rust, C++, Tokio, Git, Linux, Data structures

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, JNTU Hyderabad, 2018
